about: Why your phone gets hot when charging. Factory #35, backlog row 39, slug hotcharging. One hard idea: a battery warms up as it charges (Apple), so a warm phone on the charger is normal; when it gets too hot, the phone itself slows or pauses charging (iPhone may limit charging above 80 percent; Pixel reduces charging speeds; Galaxy charging may pause) to protect the battery, and you can check it (iPhone Settings > Battery shows if charging was on hold; Pixel Battery diagnostics shows the temperature state). Sources read 2026-11-18, see BRIEF.md.

lines.text: So why does your phone get hot when charging?
lines.say: So, why does your phone get hot when charging?

lines.text: Apple says a battery warms up as it charges.
Wireless charging and gaming make it warmer.
Too hot, and charging can stall at 80%.
lines.say: Too hot, and charging can stall at eighty percent.

lines.text: But your charger isn't broken. Your phone did that.
It slows the charge to protect the battery.
Check yours. iPhone shows if it paused in Settings, then Battery.
On Pixel, Battery diagnostics shows its temperature.
Too hot to hold? Unplug it and let it cool.
Is yours warm right now? Yes or no.
